ticks_per_psg_clock.cite: SRC-mame-intv (emulator hint only, never evidence by itself)
ticks_per_psg_clock.resolving_evidence: test: PSG tone-frequency vectors in Phase 5; measurement: D10 tone capture

ticks_per_psg_clock.note: Only an emulator hint backs this value.

scanlines_per_frame.resolving_evidence: pending: a tier 1 to 3 source for lines per frame, or a measurement
scanlines_per_frame.revisit_trigger: when a primary source or a measurement states the frame geometry
scanlines_per_frame.note: A nominal frame is 14,934 CPU cycles = 59,736 master ticks. A frame is a timeline event and is never derived by modulo.

cpu_cycles_per_scanline.resolving_evidence: pending: a tier 1 to 3 source for cycles per line, or a measurement
cpu_cycles_per_scanline.revisit_trigger: when a primary source or a measurement states the line length
cpu_cycles_per_scanline.note: A nominal frame is 14,934 CPU cycles = 59,736 master ticks. A frame is a timeline event and is never derived by modulo.

reset.r7.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 SC.1, pdf 21 and pdf 27 (the start PC is device-supplied over the bus by IAB); SRC-community-emu-docs for the $1000 default
reset.r7.note: The manual says the start PC is supplied by a device through the bus via IAB. Whether the EXEC or the board supplies it is unknown-default-chosen for Phase 2 and D5.

reset.registers_other.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 SC.1, pdf 21: other registers are undefined at reset; zero is the chosen default
reset.registers_other.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 reset read-back on owner hardware
reset.registers_other.revisit_trigger: when a source documents the reset state or a hardware read-back exists

reset.flags.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 SC.1, pdf 21: flags are undefined at reset; zero is the chosen default
reset.flags.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 reset read-back on owner hardware
reset.flags.revisit_trigger: when a source documents the reset state or a hardware read-back exists

interrupt.iab_value.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 pdf 22 (the interrupt vector is supplied over the bus by the IAB access); SRC-community-emu-docs for the $1004 value
interrupt.iab_value.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 interrupt vector read-back on owner hardware
interrupt.iab_value.revisit_trigger: when a source documents the interrupt vector or a hardware read-back exists
interrupt.iab_value.note: The core holds no vector constant. The machine bus answers the IAB access with this value for an interrupt, as reset.r7 is answered for a reset.

cpu.interrupt_accept_clears_intff.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 pdf 22, pdf 56: the pages do not say that accepting an interrupt clears the interrupt enable; not-cleared is the chosen default
cpu.interrupt_accept_clears_intff.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 repeated-interrupt probe on owner hardware
cpu.interrupt_accept_clears_intff.revisit_trigger: when a source documents the enable state after acceptance or a hardware probe exists
cpu.interrupt_accept_clears_intff.note: 0 = false, 1 = true. Stored as a number because the profile schema has no boolean value type.

bus.release_latency_cpu_cycles.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 pdf 36: the bus request timing diagram, read as a 2 CPU cycle release latency
bus.release_latency_cpu_cycles.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 bus trace on owner hardware
bus.release_latency_cpu_cycles.revisit_trigger: when a bus trace exists or the Phase 6 STIC bus-request timing depends on it

bus.wait_limit_cpu_cycles.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 pdf 12, pdf 40, pdf 43: a device must answer in under 40 microseconds; 35 CPU cycles is the derived cap
bus.wait_limit_cpu_cycles.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 slow-device probe on owner hardware
bus.wait_limit_cpu_cycles.revisit_trigger: when a bus trace exists or a device needs a longer hold

cpu.ebci_default.cite: SRC-gi-cp1600-um-1975 pdf 32, pdf 54: the manual does not state the idle level of the external condition input; false is the chosen default
cpu.ebci_default.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 external condition pin read-back on owner hardware
cpu.ebci_default.revisit_trigger: when a source documents the idle level or a hardware read-back exists
cpu.ebci_default.note: 0 = false, 1 = true. Stored as a number because the profile schema has no boolean value type.

system_images.exec_grom.value: required EXEC/GROM slot; digest bound at run time; a different digest is a different profile identity; supply policy pending D5

system_images.exec_grom.revisit_trigger: when D5 is decided or an original replacement image exists

memmap.undriven_read.cite: SRC-intv-wiki (Memory Map, oldid 14847): reads of undriven space return $FFFF, bus pull-ups being the likely mechanism; no tier 1 to 3 source found
memmap.undriven_read.resolving_evidence: measurement: D10 read-back of undriven addresses on owner hardware
memmap.undriven_read.revisit_trigger: when a source documents undriven reads or a hardware read-back exists
memmap.undriven_read.note: Also the read value of a closed gate and of an EXEC, GROM or cartridge region with no image loaded (D-17, D-19). Never $0000: decle $0000 is HLT.

memmap.device.rom10.cite: SRC-gi-1980-catalog printed 5-13 (pdf 194: the RO-3-9502 outputs 10 data bits and drives logic zero on the top six bits) and printed 5-21 (pdf 202: the RO-3-9504 drives the higher 6 bits to zero on reads)
memmap.device.rom10.revisit_trigger: when content on a non-GI ROM part is in scope
memmap.device.rom10.note: read = (stored & rmask) | (fill & ~rmask) (D-17). The fill is a driven zero, not the undriven pull-up value. Bus stores are dropped; loaders refuse a word above $03FF instead of masking it.

memmap.region.exec.cite: SRC-intv-wiki (Memory Map, oldid 14847) for $1000-$1FFF; SRC-bsr-2609 for the 4K EXEC size; SRC-gi-1980-catalog printed 5-13 (pdf 194) for the 2048 x 10 part with a mask-programmed 2K page location
memmap.region.exec.resolving_evidence: pending: an EXEC image plus board evidence for the placement of each 2K half (C20)
memmap.region.exec.revisit_trigger: when board evidence places the EXEC halves
memmap.region.exec.note: Read view only: bus writes are dropped. Reads with no EXEC image loaded return memmap.undriven_read (D-B7).
